newsitem.title: ITALY: Children not in danger from Italian food poisoning.
newsitem.headline: Children not in danger from Italian food poisoning.

text.p: Some 450 Italian schoolchildren were still in hospital in the Turin area on Thursday after an outbreak of food poisoning, health officials said.
They said none of the children was in danger and another 300 would be able to go home later in the day.

Initial investigations into Wednesday's poisoning, which affected some 700 children from elementary and kindergarten schools in the towns of Moncalieri and Giaveno, said canned sweetcorn was the most likely cause of illness.
Investigators said cans of sweetcorn used in school meals last Tuesday had been examined and showed that either a fungus or inadequate processing was behind the outbreak.
Police and health inspectors had gone to the kitchens of the company that provided the meals to take samples of the food after many children complained of stomach pains, vomiting and fever.
